articles.title: Astronomers Confirm the Youngest Planet Ever Discovered
articles.summary: A planet less than 1 million years old has been confirmed orbiting a star 450 light-years away. Named Elias 2-24 b, it's still surrounded by the dust it formed from, challenging current planet-formation models.

articles.title: A $100 Detector That Lets You See Invisible Cosmic Particles
articles.summary: Physicist Spencer Axani created CosmicWatch, a $100 muon detector the size of a box of animal crackers. It's used by high school students and researchers to study particles from space.

articles.title: Kimchi Probiotic May Help Flush Nanoplastics From the Body
articles.summary: A bacterium found in kimchi can bind to nanoplastics in the intestine and help excrete them, a new study shows. In mice, it doubled the amount of plastic leaving the body.
